subject: biochemistry
title: Biochemistry
author: U. Satyanarayan & U. Chakrapani
description: A widely-used introductory biochemistry textbook — clear explanations of biomolecules, metabolism and clinical biochemistry. Ideal for the first-year Biochemistry syllabus.

subject: anatomy
title: Abraham & McMinn's Clinical Atlas of Human Anatomy
author: Peter Abrahams, Jonathan Spratt, Marios Loukas
description: A comprehensive photographic atlas of human anatomy with clinical relevance — excellent visual companion for Gross Anatomy dissections.

subject: neuroanatomy
title: Clinical Neuroanatomy
author: Richard S. Snell
description: A clear, student-friendly introduction to neuroanatomy with clinical notes and self-assessment. Essential reference for the Neuroanatomy portion of Anatomy.

subject: embryology
title: Langman's Medical Embryology
author: T.W. Sadler
description: The classic, concise embryology text with clinically oriented examples and full-colour diagrams. A standard reference for the Embryology module.
